spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, $__interval),
  application::text AS metric,
  count(*) AS "Callbacks"
FROM callback_events
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(received_at) AND application IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2

ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz,
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST($__interval_ms / 1000.0, 60))
  ) AS t
),
teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT team FROM callback_events WHERE team IS NOT NULL
),
presence AS (
  -- which hosts called back in which minute (5 minutes of lookback before the range)
  SELECT DISTINCT team, ip, date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS m
  FROM callback_events
  WHERE team IS NOT NULL
    AND received_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    AND received_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
),
online AS (
  -- hosts of each team that called back during the 5 minutes up to each bucket
  SELECT b.t, tm.team, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ip) AS hosts
  FROM buckets b
  CROSS JOIN teams tm
  LEFT JOIN presence p
    ON p.team = tm.team
   AND p.m > b.t - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
   AND p.m <= b.t
  GROUP BY b.t, tm.team
),
weights AS (
  -- fewer compromised hosts means a bigger weight
  SELECT t, team, EXP(-${odds_sharpness} * hosts) AS w FROM online
),
odds AS (
  -- each team's share of the total weight in each bucket, as a percentage
  SELECT t, team, 100.0 * w / SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY t) AS pct FROM weights
),
leaders AS (
  -- the teams with the best odds now; only these are drawn
  SELECT team FROM odds WHERE t = (SELECT MAX(t) FROM odds) ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT ${odds_top}
)
SELECT
  t AS "time",
  team AS metric,
  pct::float8 AS "Odds"
FROM odds
WHERE team IN (SELECT team FROM leaders)
ORDER BY t, team

spec.description: Each team's chance of winning, drawn like a prediction market: the chances of all teams add up to 100%. A team's chance falls as red team holds more of its hosts (hosts that called back in the last 5 minutes) and rises as it gets them back. Only the teams with the best chances now are drawn (Teams shown). Market sharpness sets how strongly one compromised host moves the odds. It is a joke model: lost callbacks can also mean a team's own scorechecks are down.
spec.title: Odds of Winning
